description: The plot illustrates the relationship between generation temperature and Pass@8 accuracy, comparing the performance of three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT. The x-axis represents the generation temperature, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents the Pass@8 accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, marked at intervals of 2.5. The plot features three lines: On-policy RL, represented by a green line with diamond markers, LUFFY, represented by a blue line with square markers, and SFT, represented by a red line with star markers. The On-policy RL line starts at around 77.5 at a temperature of 0.1, remains relatively stable until 0.4, then declines to around 72.5 at a temperature of 1.0, with some fluctuations. The LUFFY line begins at approximately 77.5 at a temperature of 0.1, remains relatively stable until 0.4, and then gradually increases to around 79 at a temperature of 1.0, with some fluctuations. The SFT line starts at around 67.5 at a temperature of 0.1 and declines to around 65 at a temperature of 1.0, with some fluctuations.
